detailed_description: Word Cloud Generator turns a short list of weighted terms, or text pasted into the Text Input box, into an ECharts word-cloud preview. You can edit individual words and weights, load sample data, change the title, choose Default, Ocean, Sunset, or Rainbow colors, pick a shape such as Circle, Cardioid, Diamond, Triangle, or Star, adjust font-size and rotation ranges, then download the chart as PNG or SVG. The text parser performs simple browser-side word-frequency counting; it does not accept document imports, evaluate sentiment, or choose typefaces.
usage_steps: Start from the sample data or edit the word and weight rows manually.
Optionally paste text into Text Input and click Generate from Text to create weighted terms.
Set the chart title, color theme, shape, font-size range, and rotation range.
Review the live chart preview and adjust terms or weights until the layout is readable.
Download the finished word cloud as PNG or SVG.
usage_examples: Visualize common themes from a short customer-feedback sample.
Create a keyword cloud for a classroom slide or internal workshop.
Turn a list of campaign terms into a quick presentation graphic.
Compare how different weights affect emphasis before exporting a chart.

faqs.question: Can I import a document?
faqs.answer: No. The current page accepts pasted text and manual word rows; it does not include a document import control.

faqs.question: How does Generate from Text work?
faqs.answer: It lowercases the pasted text, removes punctuation, counts repeated terms, and uses the counts as chart weights.

faqs.question: Which export formats are available?
faqs.answer: The visible export buttons download PNG or SVG from the chart preview.
